channel.title: Getting Started with your Lab :: Can't Code? No Problem
channel.description: A. Lab Guide Notes Exploring vs Tasks This lab guide will walk you through some basic use cases with FortiSOAR. There will be sections that only focus on exploring and others that focus on actual tasks that need to be completed. Look for the icons below to help you understand when you will be expected to make changes. Exploring Tasks Bonus Points 💸 Scattered throughout the lab you will find various Bonus Points activities. These extra challenges are not required for completing any task in this workshop, but doing so will help solidify your understanding of the inner workings of FortiSOAR.
